The '''Peacekeeper''' was a class of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] low-[[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] patrol craft. A dozen were stationed at the [[Lola Curich Starport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]].
